headline: desired_capacity=1 conflicts with min_size=3; change will have no effect

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf diff shows desired_capacity changed to 1, but min_size remains 3 in the same resource
findings.explanation: AWS Auto Scaling Groups enforce that desired_capacity cannot be less than min_size. This configuration is invalid; the ASG will keep running 3 instances regardless. To achieve the stated goal of scaling down to 1 instance overnight, min_size must also be reduced to 1, or use scheduled actions instead.
